title: move_slide
description: Move a slide to a position (0 = first).

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.

position.description: Or its place counted from 0 (0 = first). Use after_slide_id or before_slide_id instead when you can.

after_slide_id.description: Put it right after this slide (its number or ID). The simplest way to place it.

before_slide_id.description: Put it right before this slide (its number or ID).
